summary.title: 10 Git Anti Patterns You Should be Aware of
summary.one_liner: Learn ten common Git misuse patterns that mess up history, branches and commits, and what to do instead.
takeaways: Git is powerful but easy to misuse, and common misuses can damage history, the codebase and branching strategy
Branching and merge/rebase choices are a frequent source of trouble
Commit habits and committing paradigms affect how maintainable a Git history is
The talk presents ten anti-patterns along with advice on how to avoid them
summary.summary: This is a slide deck from a talk the author gave at ITAKE UnConf 2018 on Git anti-patterns. The page text describes the talk's motivation: Git is very powerful, but teams often misuse commands, branches, merge/rebase strategies and commit habits, which messes up history and the codebase. The author draws on years of experience teaching Git to hundreds of developers. The specific ten anti-patterns are not listed in the page text, so they must be seen in the full slides.
